summary: linux-gate can be signed on a host: st-test runs the four stages a linux-gate skip covers (tests, clippy, fleet-compat, mail-redelivery-canaries) through scripts/ci-local as a heavy check; the lane and the host and agent levels (lane-bound, pull requests only) admit its notes. The author's seat runs st-test --all --push once on the head it marks ready, and the pre-push hook names the heavy checks not yet signed for the pushed tree.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes.

schema.detail: A new lane entry and by_level entries in existing files.

rules.detail: A host- or agent-signed linux-gate note counts on pull requests when signed against the base's lane definition; the check stays in shadow (enforce false) until its own flip. The merge queue runs every stage.

compatibility.detail: The pre-push hook's behavior is unchanged apart from one read-only status call and its reminder line.

manual.detail: Before marking a pull request ready, its seat runs scripts/st-test --all --push origin once on the head.

recovery.detail: Remove the by_level entries; the reminder only reads.
